g.text: GPIO4 LOW = sensor ON; HIGH = OFF. Retain HIGH in sleep.

g.desc: GPIO4 LOW = sensor ON; HIGH = OFF. Retain HIGH in sleep.

g.text: Measure frequency on GPIO5 after sensor settling; radio off during measurement.

g.desc: Measure frequency on GPIO5 after sensor settling; radio off during measurement.

g.text: J3 is an optional external probe/test connector, parallel with J4.

g.desc: J3 is an optional external probe/test connector, parallel with J4.

g.text: J4 copper is covered by solder mask. Seal probe edges before soil exposure.

g.desc: J4 copper is covered by solder mask. Seal probe edges before soil exposure.

g.text: Calibrate dry/wet in the actual soil and coating; frequency is not absolute VWC.

g.desc: Calibrate dry/wet in the actual soil and coating; frequency is not absolute VWC.

g.text: J2 pin 1 is 3.3 V OUTPUT/reference, not an external power input.

g.text: BQ25570 buck disabled. VOUT/LBUCK intentionally open.

g.text: U4 draws from VBAT directly; BAT_OK provides hysteretic shutdown.

g.desc: U4 draws from VBAT directly; BAT_OK provides hysteretic shutdown.

g.text: J1: solar source only; Voc <= 5.1 V and power <= 400 mW.

g.desc: J1: solar source only; Voc <= 5.1 V and power <= 400 mW.

g.text: SC1: Eaton PHV-5R4V305-R, low ESR. Indoor use, <= 65 C.
